prompt: In a watercolor illustration, a lively rooftop party unfolds under the night sky. On the left, a woman in a yellow dress stands holding a flute of champagne, her posture relaxed as she leans against a low brick wall. Next to her, a man in a blue suit gestures animatedly with his right hand, pointing toward the city skyline. A brown dog sits calmly on the concrete floor beside the man, looking up at him with attentive eyes. In the center, a tall potted palm tree rises above the crowd, its fronds painted in loose green strokes. A girl in a pink shirt stands next to the tree, reaching out to touch a leaf. Behind them, a silver grill emits faint wisps of smoke, attended by a chef in a white hat who is flipping a burger. To the right of the grill, a woman in a black coat watches the cooking process, holding a plate. A stack of red cups rests on a wooden table near the edge of the roof. A teenager in a hoodie sits on the table, swinging their legs. A cat with orange fur perches on the railing nearby, observing the scene. A man in a green scarf talks to a woman in a purple dress, handing her a napkin. They stand close together, sharing a quiet moment amidst the noise. A boombox sits on the floor, playing music for the gathering. A dancer in a sequined top moves rhythmically near the speaker. A child in a striped shirt runs past the dancer, chasing a red balloon. An elderly man in a gray cap watches the child from a folding chair. A lantern hangs from a string overhead, casting a warm glow. There is no snow on the ground. There is no swimming pool visible. There is no helicopter in the sky.
